From the reader

Reviews & reflections

A useful review helps the next reader decide whether a book is right for them.

Read what readers think

Reader reviews are hosted on Amazon alongside each book. This site does not copy Amazon reviews or show a combined star rating of its own: the listing for the edition you are interested in shows the reviews available there.

Visit my Amazon author page (opens in a new tab)

Share an honest review

If you have read a book, you can leave your own review on its Amazon page, subject to Amazon’s review rules and a signed-in Amazon account. Positive, mixed and critical responses can all help other readers.

You might mention who you think the book is for, which topics were useful, and what you would have liked it to explore further. Please avoid patient information, identifiable workplace stories or other people’s personal details.

Write to the author

A correction or a private note?

For a factual correction, tell me the book title, format, chapter or page and the passage concerned. Please include a source where relevant.

Private feedback is not permission to publish a testimonial. I will ask separately, in writing, before quoting your words or identifying you on this site.
